subject: spaceGalley
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.

requests.what: A long industrial fluorescent light bar under the ceiling, with a ribbed dark housing, six alternating pale green and amber lamps, and four chunky metal brackets. Keep it functional and rectangular, not futuristic.
Four oversized stove knobs and two tiny red indicator lamps on the plain stove fascia. Knobs are cream with black centres; lamps are red and amber.
A heavy gooseneck faucet behind the sink, made of dark steel pipe with a cream hexagonal mounting collar and two small hot/cold valves.
A thick dark rubber counter lip around the front and side edges, with broad rectangular corner guards. It should make the worktop feel sealed and shipboard.
Rows of rugged vertical pull handles on the lower galley doors, alternating steel and ochre warning-painted handles. Add small dark hinge blocks at the door corners.
Six large mechanical quarter-turn latches and three narrow black rubber seams across the overhead locker doors. The latches are dull steel circles with ochre centres.
A compact pipe manifold on the rear wall: four parallel pipes, two elbow joints, and a rectangular valve block. Use dark steel, green enamel and tiny red caps.
A small bolted cream safety placard on the rear bulkhead with a red diagonal warning stripe and three dark raised bars. Do not use readable text.
A bank of deep horizontal ventilation slots and a small green status lamp on the refrigerator door. The slots are recessed black bars with steel rims.
A square grated floor drain beneath the sink, with a dark inset, four steel rim plates and diagonal crossing bars.
Subtle uneven industrial wear in HULL_DARK, PANEL and GREEN: broad vertical grime bands, chipped edges and a few faded olive maintenance patches. Keep it restrained and matte.
A worn cream enamel surface with darker green-grey edge shading, small scuffs near the sink and stove, and a few thin brown grease marks. No modern polished finish.
Faded stencilled maintenance markings in CREAM_LIGHT and OCHRE on the locker fronts: small block numerals, arrows and interrupted caution bands, low contrast and weathered.
